# Third-party files served by the app (offline, no CDN)

| Folder | What | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three/` | Three.js r187: core build and GLTF loader | npm package `three` 0.187.0 | MIT (`three/LICENSE`) |
| `avatar/` | Talking avatar: Business_Female_01 (facial version) trimmed to head and shoulders with 40 face shapes; textures resized to 1024 px | Microsoft Rocketbox avatar library (github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox) | MIT |

Only the files the avatar needs are copied. To update, replace them from a newer `three` package keeping the same paths.
